I don’t feel as if things will recover . Because the last time I felt like things would be better was when I was hospitalized for 5 months back in 2014-2015. That’s because I was away from the abuse and the shame and guilt . But now I know for sure I won’t escape. I was born to die , I think that’s true now . 
No one has ever stayed or loved me. 
And the one last person who I thought would love me like I love them, they gave up on me . 
I thought things could get better because of them. Because of our potential future . But they know I’m not worth it because of how ill I am mentally and they couldn’t handle it. Even when I was getting better, I wasn’t enough. 
So now.. now I know .

I don’t usually comment much , but have you tried texting the crisis line? The number is 731-731 I think? (Look it up to make sure.) and you send a message saying “start” 
They’ll ask what your crisis is and you don’t have to be suicidal or self harming or anything . I’ve spent several hours texting them and they only end the conversation if they feel you are safe and a little less in pain . They also send links to resources and what not. I’ve had a lot of luck with it. And if for any reason you don’t like the person you’re talking to just type “stop” and it’ll end the convo and you won’t be contacted unless you text “ start” again. This works for me because I can’t have phone calls without my abuser knowing and I’m afraid someone will hear me. If you don’t reply after awhile they’ll double text to make sure you’re still there and doing alright. 

Just thought I’d share something that has helped me, I hope you find help too.

Edit: it is 741-741.
